purpose: Bound TP2 native-MTP4 eager/F16 expansion to exact 16K and 24K only after the clean exact-4K TP2/MTP4 sentinel. Each included depth requires isolated positive conserved acceptance, exact same-topology TP2/MTP0 parity, full objective and baseline quality, TP2 topology, rank-cache/model gates, cleanup, and a clean pushed main. No other depth, publication, replacement, or automatic expansion is authorized.

passed_4k_gate.gate: Terminal state passed-quality-clean-sentinel with exact/cache-zero 4K, positive conserved 90/148 acceptance, exact TP2/MTP0 parity, objective and baseline quality, TP2 topology, rank-cache isolation, and cleanup all passing. The sentinel itself authorized no automatic expansion; this separately preregistered two-depth packet is the only new authority.

target_oracles.gate: Each candidate must exactly match all 128 token IDs in its same-image, same-topology TP2/MTP0 eager/F16 target receipt. No TP1, TP4, MTP1-3, or other-depth output is a target.

mtp3_parent.gate: The clean TP2/MTP3 parent must retain both independently valid 16K/24K depth and verification receipts plus global objective/baseline quality, TP2 topology, rank-cache isolation, and cleanup. It is mechanism-parent evidence, not a target oracle.

historical_risk_and_exclusions.0: No literal exact-zero fixture; missing and not inferred.
historical_risk_and_exclusions.2048: Excluded from this first expansion; no authority from the 4K sentinel.
historical_risk_and_exclusions.4096: Already closed by the passed sentinel; not rerun here.
historical_risk_and_exclusions.8192: Existing same-profile TP2/MTP4 token-99 target-divergence quarantine; no speed and no rerun here.
historical_risk_and_exclusions.32768: Excluded because MTP4 exact-32K caused runtime-fatal speculative-shape failure on TP1 and carries higher risk on TP4; no automatic escalation from 16K/24K.
historical_risk_and_exclusions.gate: The executable depth list is exactly [16384,24576]. No result can clear 8K, infer x0/2K/32K, or authorize a new depth.

speculator_binding.type: native embedded Qwen MTP; no external draft model

acceptance_contract.snapshot_scope: Both speculative counters immediately before and after each included exact request, with no intervening traffic.
acceptance_contract.gate: All before/after/delta values finite; counters nondecreasing; drafted_delta > 0; accepted_delta > 0; accepted_delta <= drafted_delta.

quality_contract.gate: pass_all, baseline_match_all, seven exact cases, eight deterministic repeats, long-context needle, and all 16 usage records cached_tokens == 0.

terminal_classification.passed-quality-clean-two-depth-expansion: Both exact, isolated acceptance, same-topology parity, quality, topology, rank-cache, model, and cleanup gates pass.
terminal_classification.partial-two-depth-expansion: Global gates pass but one included depth fails exact, acceptance, or parity; retain evidence without automatic publication or further expansion.
terminal_classification.quarantined-quality-failed: Objective/cache-zero or same-topology baseline quality fails.
terminal_classification.unsupported: Only an explicit exact-image native-MTP unsupported line qualifies.
terminal_classification.failed: Infrastructure, binding, startup, identity, metrics, topology, rank-cache, model, clean-main, or cleanup failure.
